_meta.description: Structured testability mapping: required test patterns per gate class, derived from contracts and gap analysis. Intended for automated test generation and coverage tracking.

patternDefinitions.truth-table-exhaustive: Run all 2^N input combinations and verify outputs match evaluate() spec. Applicable only to combinational gates with N ≤ 6 inputs.
patternDefinitions.sequential-step-sequence: Apply a time-ordered sequence of input stimuli and verify state transitions and output responses at each step.
patternDefinitions.async-control-override: Assert async control (SET/RESET/PRESET/CLEAR) while clock is stable and verify output changes immediately without waiting for clock edge.
patternDefinitions.oe-tristate: Toggle /OE and verify outputs switch between driven (0/1) and Hi-Z (2) values.
patternDefinitions.multi-driver-conflict: Connect two or more gates driving the same net; verify the simulation engine raises the correct race/conflict event.
patternDefinitions.export-verilog: Call toVerilog() and verify the produced string parses as valid Verilog, contains expected port references, and matches behavioral spec.
patternDefinitions.export-vhdl: Call toVHDL() and verify the produced string parses as valid VHDL and matches behavioral spec.
patternDefinitions.ui-state-projection: Verify stateKeys match the values displayed in the STT/UI, and that forcing state via STT produces the expected simulation output.
patternDefinitions.reset-to-known-state: Apply async or sync reset and verify all Q outputs go to 0 (or preset value) and state is cleared.
patternDefinitions.clock-edge-detection: Apply all 4 CLK transitions (0→0, 0→1, 1→0, 1→1) and verify state only changes on the active edge.
patternDefinitions.hold-state: Verify Q remains unchanged when no active clock edge or enable signal occurs.
patternDefinitions.forbidden-input-combination: Apply an illegal input combination (e.g. S=R=1, /PRE=/CLR=0) and verify the model produces its documented deterministic output.
patternDefinitions.counter-rollover: Count from max value (15 or 99) and verify the counter wraps to 0 and RCO/carry behavior is correct.
patternDefinitions.shift-sequence: Apply a serial bit sequence and verify each bit propagates through all register stages correctly.
patternDefinitions.load-shift-mode: Test parallel-load then shift mode transition; verify loaded value shifts correctly on subsequent clock edges.

gateClasses.description: Rising-edge-triggered D, JK, T, SR flip-flops
gateClasses.notes: D_FF_R: verify RST overrides clock synchronously. SR_FF_EDGE: verify S=R=1 at CLK↑.
Assert S=1 or R=1 independently with CLK stable; verify immediate effect. Test S=R=1 (undefined: maps to Q=0).
Q changes only on falling edge. Master tracks during CLK=1. HDL export approximates as negedge-triggered — synthesis-risk.
REG4 has EN gate; verify hold when EN=0. PISO4 serial output should emit bits in correct order.
Critical: 74HC161 clear is ASYNC (apply /CLRN mid-cycle, verify immediate reset). 74HC163 clear is SYNC (verify reset waits for CLK↑). BIN_CTR7S/99: no HDL export — export tests skip.
Test write cycle (/WE=0, /CS=0) then read cycle (/OE=0, /CS=0) at same address. ROM: verify /CS /OE control. Both: verify Hi-Z output when /OE=1.
Test both FFs independently. /PRE=/CLR=0: Q=1,Qn=1 (both HIGH). Test async PRE before CLK and CLR during CLK.
Verify SHCP advances shift register, STCP latches to output. /MR resets shift only. /OE enables outputs. /OE fix needed (see gap analysis §3).
Test all 4 modes: S1S0=00 (hold), 01 (shift-right, SR input), 10 (shift-left, SL input), 11 (parallel load). /CLRN is async.
When LE=1: transparent (Q=D). When LE=0: latched. /OE=1: Hi-Z. Needs defaultInputValues fix for /OE.
Verify state update happens at CLK↑ even when /OE=1 (outputs Hi-Z but internal state updates). Needs /OE defaultInputValues fix.
74HC138: active-low enable inputs — defaultInputValues verify correct behavior when G2A/G2B left unconnected. 74HC148: active-low I/O encoding.
No simulation test patterns required. These become module ports in HDL. Verify HDL serializer handles them correctly as port declarations.
Display-only components. No HDL export. Verify UI renders correct value from input signal.

coverageMatrix.description: Summary of which test patterns apply to which gate classes.
coverageMatrix.note: Use this to generate a per-gate test plan. Each gate in a class inherits the class patterns plus any gate-specific additionalRequired.
